author: Camp Director
title: Pre-Season Staff Training Concludes
summary: Our 2026 Camp Lawton staff completed intensive pre-season training, including Wilderness First Aid, archery range safety, and Leave No Trace principles.

author: Program Director
title: Spotting the Catalina Coati on Mt. Lemmon
summary: Nature staff reports multiple sightings of the white-nosed coati near Camp Lawton. Learn how our Nature study merit badge will observe them safely.

author: Facilities Committee
title: Pool Renovations Completed for Summer
summary: Thanks to council donations and volunteer work, the Camp Lawton swimming pool features a newly resurfaced deck and upgraded heating units.

author: Eagle Association
title: Eagle Scout Project Restores Historic Cabins
summary: Scouts from Troop 121 completed structural repairs and fresh staining on the historic Adirondack-style cabins at the west end of camp.
